episodes.synopsis: Shinsuke plans to attack a local group of brigands, only to be beaten to the punch by the eccentric Tama and Jinka. Impressed by their prowess in battle, Shinsuke becomes determined to follow them, and offers to take them to the brigands' leader.
episodes.title: We Are Those Who Lament This Barbaric Age

episodes.synopsis: The party retreats after failing to defeat the rampaging katawara. The monks in their party are shocked when they learn exactly who taught Jinka the secret of spirit transformation. Shinsuke, in turn, is shocked to learn the katawara's true origins.
episodes.title: Shakugan

episodes.synopsis: Jinka pours his fury out on the Dangaisyuu temple, prompting the local leaders to discuss moving operations elsewhere. Meanwhile, Tama tells Shinsuke and Shakugan a little more about herself and Jinka's spirit transformation.
episodes.title: Year Seven of the Eiroku Period

episodes.synopsis: Shinsuke and Shakugan are staying with Jinka and Tama, but Shinsuke isn't learning much in the way of fighting skills. Instead, Shinsuke is left behind to do chores when Tama and Jinka are informed of trouble with a local katawara.
episodes.title: Jinka and Humans

episodes.synopsis: Shinsuke starts training with Zanzou, who's recuperating in a mountain cave and requests payment in the form of food. Zanzou tells Shinsuke about his sister, and how she came to join the Dangaisyuu as a nun.
episodes.title: Higan

episodes.synopsis: Raidou departs the party, but not without giving Shinsuke a surprising gift first. The journey to Kagan's home is long, and the others are exhausted when they cross paths with a group of monkey katawara.
episodes.title: Fukou

episodes.synopsis: The party finally reaches Kagan's hometown, a settlement of katawara. Coincidentally, a pregnant human arrives at the same time, seeking shelter so she can give birth. Not coincidentally, some Dangaisyuu agents also arrive...
episodes.title: Kagan & Shakuyaku

episodes.synopsis: The group's latest battle against the Dangaisyuu pushes Shinsuke to the brink, making him more desperate for strength than ever before. Luckily, they also encounter what appears to be a powerful new ally.
episodes.title: Mystic Swordsman

episodes.synopsis: Jinka, Tama, and Shinsuke meet with the Mountain Goddess to discuss their next course of action against the Dangaisyuu, while Jinun and Senya continue to hunt for them.
episodes.title: The Mountain Goddess (1)

episodes.synopsis: With their training complete, the Mountain Godess intends on having the party attack the Daigansyuu. But Tama has a different plan in mind.
episodes.title: The Mountain Goddess (2)

episodes.synopsis: Jinka and Douren square off as Shinsuke and Resshin try to kill each other.
episodes.title: The Strongest of the Dangaisyuu

episodes.synopsis: Battles unfold in parallel with Jinka and Shinsuke taking on Douren and Resshin. But even if they succeed, how can they take down Taizan, who's been turned into a walking fortress?
episodes.title: Jinka & Douren, Takekichi & Barry

episodes.synopsis: Jinka squares off for the final battle against Yazen, but as the two spiritually transformed humans fight, Jinka treads into dangerous territory.
episodes.title: Godbeast
